Sophie: Quick: need a single-page solution brief for compliance-heavy customers (one pager downloadable + small email to field). Layout idea: top metric, security snapshot, micro-bench, routing + CTA. Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/compliance-onepager

Liam: Love that. Can we include a one-line note about graceful model fallbacks and an ops blurb about token-level observability? Field asks for that.

Nadia: Bench owner here. Latest run (2026-04-01): text-gen-3 @ 512 tokens p95 = 65ms on Dedicated; median cost per 1k tokens = $0.38. Self-host baseline we sampled averaged $0.66/k. Rough unit-cost improvement ~42%. I'll drop the CSV in Drive with attribution.

Evan: For the routing playbook, here's a compact pasteable snippet for sales to copy into playbooks:

```
# inbound routing example
if customer.region == 'APAC' and customer.requires_data_residency:
    route = 'private-vpc-apac'
elif customer.commitment >= 20000:
    route = 'dedicated-reservation'
else:
    route = 'hosted-api'
```

Sophie: Nice. Webinar demo idea: live failover (hosted -> dedicated -> private) + KMS walkthrough + audit log example. Proposed date Apr 20 10:00 PT. Can LaunchQueue hold that if assets land by Apr 16 EOD?

Liam: Also propose an A/B test on landing headline: Variant A = "Compliance-first inference with SLAs" vs Variant B = "Guaranteed latency. Lower cost." Measure CTR and gated download conversion.

Nadia: Adding a short FAQ bullet list: SOC2 type II, ISO27001, HIPAA options, KMS/HSM integrations, audit log retention options. Will include bench sources and test methodology in the appendix for field.

Evan: For social and email, we need: 1) 30s explainer script, 2) hero graphic, 3) webinar landing copy. Field wants a one-line tech blurb they can paste into outreach.

LaunchQueue: Landing page scaffold created: https://redwood.app/landing/compliance-inference. I can queue announcement for Apr 20 10:00 PT if assets arrive by Apr 16 17:00 PT.

Sophie: Assignments: Sophie = final copy + one-pager layout; Nadia = bench slides + raw csv; Liam = A/B messaging + webinar flow; Evan = demo infra + routing snippet; LaunchQueue = landing + scheduling. Will post first PDF draft here when ready. :rocket:
